Class KeyedStorages

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.KeyedStorages
public final class KeyedStorages extends Object
Factories for KeyedStorage — a Storage that declares its own PersistentContainerKey so M1 per-slot metadata persists for registered slots (§0045).

The player-scoped factory is the supported path for registering player-owned storage (IP Pockets, IP Equipment Slots) with per-slot metadata. It wraps a content Storage (typically bound from a StorageAttachment) and tags it with a PersistentContainerKey.Modded key whose payload encodes the owning player. M1's ContainerKeyResolver routes the registered slot to this key; the server resolves it to a resolver-id-namespaced bag on the player (so distinct slots, and distinct mods, never collide).

The payload shape is library-owned — these are library-produced keys, distinct from the consumer-defined opaque payloads of §0034's general modded-resolver path. The keys below are the contract between this factory and SlotStateServer's Modded resolution.

  • Method Details

    • player

      public static KeyedStorage player(com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.Storage backing, net.minecraft.resources.Identifier resolverId, UUID playerId)
      Wraps backing as a player-scoped KeyedStorage. The returned storage delegates all content operations to backing and reports a stable PersistentContainerKey.Modded key identifying (resolverId, playerId) — so per-slot metadata written against the registered slots persists on the player, namespaced by resolverId.

      The key is equality-stable across the client/server boundary (same resolver-id + same payload content), satisfying KeyedStorage's contract.

      Parameters:
      backing - the content storage (e.g. POCKETS.bind(player))
      resolverId - stable identity of this slot (e.g. "inventory-plus:pockets"); namespaces the bag
      playerId - the owning player's UUID
